fusions.name: Bursting Puffball
fusions.desc: Lobs a puffball that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Choking Huff
fusions.desc: Huffs a cone of spores that deals 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of leaving the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Net
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Mossback
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, you regenerate 0.6 health a second, and your poison resistance rises by 12%.
